Cut from the article: "These February 2014 Final Master files are the last combined printable master this wiki has on file from before that announce. They are not automatically the post-Reset frozen “Master Legacy PDF” named in the July post." The article no longer says these are the ''last'' pre-Reset master; only that they are the combined master on file.
